items.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization

items.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback

items.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models

items.why: MoE 大模型的高效训练与推理代表工作，对低成本大模型路线影响显著。

items.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
items.why: 以强化学习激发推理能力的代表性工作，推动推理模型成为研究热点。

items.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
items.why: 覆盖多尺寸、多语言与长上下文能力的开放模型技术报告。

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.why: 提出思维链提示，显著提升大模型的复杂推理能力。

items.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
items.why: 将推理与工具行动结合，是 AI Agent 的核心基础论文之一。

items.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
items.why: 展示语言模型自主调用外部工具的可行路径。

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
items.why: 提出 RAG，成为知识增强、搜索问答和企业知识库的基础方法。

items.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
items.why: DPO 简化偏好对齐流程，成为 RLHF 之外的重要对齐方法。

items.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
items.why: 提出基于原则与 AI 反馈的安全对齐框架。

items.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
items.why: 低秩微调方法，大幅降低大模型适配与部署成本。

items.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
items.why: 重构注意力计算的显存与速度路径，成为长上下文训练基础设施。

items.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
items.why: 推动稀疏 MoE 架构在大模型中的规模化应用。

items.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
items.why: 以选择性状态空间挑战 Transformer 的长序列计算瓶颈。

items.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
items.why: DDPM 奠定现代扩散生成模型的理论与训练基础。

items.title: Diffusion Models Beat GANs on Image Synthesis
items.why: 证明扩散模型在图像生成质量上可以超越 GAN。

items.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
items.why: Latent Diffusion/Stable Diffusion 的基础论文，推动高质量图像生成普及。

items.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
items.why: CLIP 建立图文对比学习范式，成为多模态模型的重要基础。

items.why: ViT 证明 Transformer 可以成为通用视觉主干网络。

items.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
items.why: 展示少样本视觉语言模型的跨模态推理能力。

items.title: Segment Anything
items.why: SAM 推动通用图像分割与视觉基础模型的发展。

items.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
items.why: 3DGS 以实时高质量渲染推动三维重建与生成式 3D 发展。

items.title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.why: NeRF 开创神经辐射场，成为三维视觉与场景重建的重要基础。

items.title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.why: AlphaFold 2 解决长期困扰生物学的蛋白质结构预测难题。

items.title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search
items.why: AlphaGo 是深度强化学习与复杂博弈结合的里程碑。

hot.note: Hugging Face Daily Papers 近 21 天按点赞、评论与时效综合排序。

items.title: Motion Mamba 2.0: Autoregressive Diffusion Mamba for Long-Horizon Humanoid Control
items.summary: Long-horizon, real-time controllable motion generation is essential for interactive animation and humanoid robotics, where an agent must respond to changing instructions and spatial goals while moving. Existing autoregressive diffusion methods generate motion incrementally, but bounded attention caches limit access to distant history, while repeated denoising introduces substantial inference overhead. items.title: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
items.summary: WorldLeague benchmarks 13 AI systems on 60 simulated robot tasks spanning exploration, rearrangement, and adaptation, measuring progress and success to compare autonomous physical goal achievement.

items.title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
items.summary: Constraining residual stream mixing within the Birkhoff polytope via geometric contraction improves stability and scalability of hyper-connections in large-scale dense and mixture-of-experts model pretraining.

items.title: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
items.summary: A systematic framework shows that frontier multimodal models can serve as robot policies when harnessed with interfaces favoring native visual reasoning and tool use, achieving high success in simulated and real manipulation tasks.

items.title: Non-penetrating World Models
items.summary: A benchmark and lightweight framework leverage hidden states from frozen diffusion transformers to detect and prevent object penetration in interactive video world models, reducing physical violations and generalizing zero-shot.

items.title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
items.summary: A new benchmark evaluates rigging and motion generation across six 3D morphology categories, compares specialized, video-based, and agent-driven paradigms, and proposes an agentic framework that writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs executed deterministically for reliable control.

items.title: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
items.summary: WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models spanning dense and mixture-of-experts sizes, is trained with continued pre-training and hybrid-thinking post-training to achieve strong e-commerce and general-purpose results and is deployed in WeChat.

items.title: A Glimpse of Training VLMs as Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: nanoAstra combines semantic action modeling with capability-preserving supervised fine-tuning to train vision-language models for generalizable robot manipulation, achieving strong zero-shot success and faster streaming execution.

items.title: Let the Fixer Decide: Training a Code Localizer from the Fixer's Likelihood
items.summary: A code localizer is trained with scores from a frozen fixer via weighted supervised fine-tuning, improving bug localization and patch success for a small coding agent without tests or reinforcement learning.

items.title: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.summary: Future-OPSD trains vision-language models via on-policy self-distillation and a contrastive privilege advantage derived from a foresight score, improving video foresight prediction and planning without extra annotations or LLM supervision.
